exposure: Gestational Trophoblastic Neoplasia (GTN) with Leptomeningeal Disease (LMD)
second line paclitaxel, cisplatin alternating with paclitaxel, etoposide (TP/TE) chemotherapy
cohort: The study included five patients with Gestational Trophoblastic Neoplasia (GTN) who presented with features of Leptomeningeal disease (LMD).
finding: All five patients with GTN and LMD remained cured within a 2-6 year follow-up, demonstrating excellent survival outcomes with the avoidance of whole-brain radiotherapy and reporting mild neurological symptoms that do not affect functionality and quality of life.
